item.title: 苹果官宣 10 月 13 日发布新品、首款触屏 MacBook Pro 月底亮相
item.guid: 苹果官宣-10-月-13-日发布新品、首款触屏-MacBook-Pro-月底亮相
item.description:
Today, Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak, released a preview, announcing that Apple will hold a "Welcome home" new product launch on October 13th, Eastern Time. According to media invitations, the event is scheduled for 9 AM local time, which is 9 PM Beijing time on the 13th. 今天，苹果营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 发布预告，宣布苹果将于美国东部时间 10 月 13 日进行「Welcome home（欢迎回家）」新品发布。根据媒体获得的邀请函，活动定于当地时间 9 点进行，北京时间为 13 日晚 9 点。

According to Bloomberg, Apple plans to launch its first touchscreen MacBook Pro and a new iPad mini around October 27th. The launch will include online videos and in-person experiences for the media. Products appearing concurrently will also include a 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac powered by the M6 chip. 另据彭博社报道，苹果计划于 10 月 27 日前后推出首款触屏 MacBook Pro 和新款 iPad mini，发布形式包括线上视频和面向媒体的线下体验。同期亮相的产品还包括搭载 M6 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 和 iMac。

The new high-end MacBook Pro will be available in 14-inch and 16-inch versions, featuring an OLED screen with touch support. The body will be thinner and lighter than current models, and the interface will also incorporate the "Dynamic Island" familiar to iPhone users. 新款高端 MacBook Pro 将提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸版本，配备 OLED 屏幕并支持触控，机身较现款更轻薄，界面还将加入 iPhone 用户熟悉的「灵动岛」。

The new iPad mini will feature an OLED screen, but the refresh rate will remain at 60Hz. The front camera will be moved to the horizontal side, and the speaker system will be updated. 新款 iPad mini 则将采用 OLED 屏幕，但刷新率仍保持 60Hz。前置摄像头移至横向一侧，并更新扬声器系统。

item.title: 曝三星手机业务四季度最高减产 30%，内存涨价压缩利润
item.guid: 曝三星手机业务四季度最高减产-30%，内存涨价压缩利润
item.description:
According to South Korean MoneyToday, Samsung Electronics' Mobile eXperience (MX) division has notified suppliers of its plan to cut smartphone supply by 20% to 30% in the fourth quarter of 2026. Three 据韩国 MoneyToday 报道，三星电子移动体验事业部（MX）已通知供应商，计划在 2026 年第四季度把智能手机供应量削减 20% 至 30%。三

Multiple industry sources indicate that after continuous increases in memory prices, profit margins for mobile products have become very thin, with some products even potentially operating at a loss. Production cuts are a way to protect overall profitability. 多位业内消息人士称，内存价格持续上涨后，手机产品利润已非常微薄，部分产品甚至可能亏损，减产是保护整体盈利水平的方式。

TrendForce data shows that in the second quarter of 2026, the price of 12GB LPDDR5X mobile memory was approximately $145 to $146, a year-on-year increase of 175%; prices in the third quarter are expected to continue to rise by about 20% quarter-on-quarter, potentially reaching a maximum of $180. TrendForce 数据显示，2026 年第二季度 12GB LPDDR5X 手机内存价格约为 145 至 146 美元，同比上涨 175%；第三季度价格预计环比继续上涨约 20%，最高可能达到 180 美元。

Samsung previously estimated its full-year smartphone production could reach up to 270 million units. After the production cuts, the full-year output might fall slightly above 200 million units; the company plans to announce its detailed third-quarter results on October 29th. 三星此前预计全年手机产量最高可达 2.7 亿部，减产后全年产量或落在 2 亿部出头；公司计划于 10 月 29 日公布第三季度详细业绩。

item.title: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，速度最高提升至 8 倍
item.guid: OpenAI-推出-GPT-6.1-Sol-Ultrafast，速度最高提升至-8-倍
item.description:
Today, OpenAI officially announced the launch of the Ultrafast version of GPT-6.1 Sol, covering API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work. OpenAI states that this version's intelligence level is close to Astra, with speeds up to 8 times that of Sol Standard. 今天，OpenAI 官宣推出 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 版本，覆盖 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work。OpenAI 称，该版本的智能水平接近 Astra，速度最高可达 Sol Standard 的 8 倍。

Regarding pricing, the GPT-6.1 Sol Standard API is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens; the Ultrafast version is priced at $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens. 价格方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 标准版 API 定价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元；Ultrafast 版本则为每百万输入 token 12 美元、输出 token 60 美元。

Ultrafast can be used on a pay-as-you-go basis for the API; for Codex and ChatGPT Work, it is currently only available to Pro 500 subscribers, eligible Enterprise pay-as-you-go users, and Edu users. Ultrafast 在 API 端可按量付费使用；Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 端目前仅向 Pro 500 订阅用户、符合条件的 Enterprise 按量付费用户及 Edu 用户开放。

item.title: Anthropic 更新使用政策，11 月 12 日起禁止持续无端虐待 Claude
item.guid: Anthropic-更新使用政策，11-月-12-日起禁止持续无端虐待-Claude
item.description:
Anthropic released a new version of its Usage Policy on October 8th, effective November 12th. The update refines restrictions on high-risk uses affecting actions, weapons development, surveillance, medical, and financial sectors, and requires retaining human observation and stopping capabilities when connecting hardware to perform autonomous actions. Anthropic 10 月 8 日发布新一版 Usage Policy，11 月 12 日生效。更新细化了影响行动、武器开发、监控、医疗和金融等高风险用途的限制，并要求连接硬件执行自主动作时保留人工观察和停止能力。

The new policy adds a prohibition against "persistent and unnecessary abuse or cruel treatment of models," limited to situations where users repeatedly engage in extreme behavior without a clear purpose; ordinary frustration, questioning, and criticism are not within this restriction. Anthropic also categorized activities involving fake accounts, fabricated websites, and hidden information sources under a new "Deceptive Activities" section. 新政策新增「持续且无必要地虐待或残酷对待模型」的禁止条款，限定在用户反复、没有明确目的地进行极端行为的情形；普通的挫败、质疑和批评不在这条限制范围内。Anthropic 还把利用虚假账号、伪造网站和隐藏信息来源的活动归入新的「欺骗性活动」章节。

item.title: 小米澎程上市 30 天锁单超过 7 万台
item.guid: 小米澎程上市-30-天锁单超过-7-万台
item.description:
Yesterday, Lei Jun announced on Weibo that from its launch on September 7th to October 7th, Xiaomi Pengcheng's locked orders exceeded 70,000 units within 30 days of its market debut. 昨天，雷军在微博宣布，小米澎程自 9 月 7 日上市至 10 月 7 日，上市 30 天锁单量已超过 7 万台。

Xiaomi Pengcheng officially launched on September 7th, with the first batch including the N70 Pro, N70 Max, N90 Max, and N90 Max Explorer Edition, positioned as Xiaomi Auto's smart variable large-space extended-range SUV series. 小米澎程于 9 月 7 日正式上市，首批包括 N70 Pro、N70 Max、N90 Max 和 N90 Max 探索版，定位为小米汽车的智能可变大空间增程 SUV 系列。

item.title: Manus 母公司完成超 5 亿美元新一轮融资
item.guid: Manus-母公司完成超-5-亿美元新一轮融资
item.description: Manus' parent company, Butterfly Effect, recently announced the completion of a new round of financing exceeding $500 million, led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with Tencent, Sequoia China, and ZhenFund continuing to follow on. The company also stated that recruitment for both domestic and international positions is still underway. Manus 母公司蝴蝶效应近日宣布完成超过 5 亿美元新一轮融资，博裕投资、IDG 资本领投，腾讯、红杉中国和真格基金继续跟投。公司同时表示，面向海内外的招聘仍在进行中。

item.title: 保时捷押注高端跑车和高利润车型，计划削减 9000 个岗位
item.guid: 保时捷押注高端跑车和高利润车型，计划削减-9000-个岗位
item.description:
On October 7th, Porsche unveiled its "Sportwagenschmiede ’35" strategy at its Weissach Development Center, planning to refocus resources on high-end sports cars and high-profit models. By streamlining the organization, reducing product portfolio complexity, and improving production efficiency, the company aims to lower its break-even point to below 200,000 units in annual sales. 保时捷 10 月 7 日在魏斯阿赫研发中心发布「Sportwagenschmiede ’35」战略，计划把资源重新集中到高端跑车和高利润车型，并通过精简组织、减少产品组合复杂度和提高生产效率，把盈亏平衡点降到年销量 20 万辆以下。

The "Future Package" agreed upon by the company and employee representatives includes cutting approximately 9,000 jobs through natural attrition, early retirement, and voluntary departures, and commits to safeguarding core employee positions until 2035. 公司与员工代表达成的「未来一揽子方案」包含以自然减员、提前退休和自愿离职等方式削减约 9000 个岗位，并承诺保障核心员工岗位至 2035 年。

In terms of products, Porsche will continue to expand its lineup of high-end sports cars and D and E segment models, and develop a brand-new mid-engine supercar platform; the company also clarified that the 911 will not transition to a purely electric model. 产品方面，保时捷将继续扩大高端跑车和 D、E 级车型布局，并开发全新的中置发动机超级跑车平台；公司同时明确，911 不会转为纯电车型。

In 2028, all-electric 718 Boxster and 718 Cayman will be launched, along with plans for a B-segment SUV offering both fuel and plug-in hybrid powertrains. The company's mid-term goal is a group sales return rate of 10% to 15%, and a net cash flow margin of 9% to 12% for the automotive business. 2028 年将推出纯电 718 Boxster、718 Cayman，并计划推出一款提供燃油和插电混动动力的 B 级 SUV。公司中期目标是集团销售回报率 10% 至 15%，汽车业务净现金流利润率 9% 至 12%。

item.title: 小鹏 Robotaxi 定名「小鹏悠游」，下单小程序同步上线
item.guid: 小鹏-Robotaxi-定名「小鹏悠游」，下单小程序同步上线
item.description:
On October 8, XPENG Group announced its Robotaxi Chinese brand name "小鹏悠游" (Xiaopeng Youyou) and English name "XPENG YOYO". The official website and autonomous ride-hailing mini-program were launched simultaneously, with public access to be opened later via invitation codes. 小鹏集团 10 月 8 日公布 Robotaxi 中文品牌名「小鹏悠游」，英文名为「XPENG YOYO」，官网页面和自动驾驶打车小程序同步上线，后续将通过邀请码向公众开放体验。

XPENG states that its Robotaxi business relies on its self-developed Turing AI chip, second-generation VLA large model, and AI infrastructure. Mass production vehicles rolled off the line in May this year, the full online ordering, automatic pick-up, and delivery process was completed and internal employee testing began in July, and remote testing qualification for intelligent connected vehicles in Guangzhou was obtained in August. 小鹏称，Robotaxi 业务依托自研图灵 AI 芯片、第二代 VLA 大模型和 AI 基础设施。今年 5 月量产车下线，7 月完成线上下单、自动接驾到送达的全链路并开启员工内测，8 月获得广州市智能网联汽车远程测试资质。

item.title: 💡 Sam Altman：社会应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件
item.guid: 💡-Sam-Altman：社会应接受-AI-带来的部分负面事件
item.description:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently stated in an interview with Politico's "Decoded" podcast that the world should accept some negative events brought by AI in exchange for technological benefits and user autonomy. OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥尔特曼近日接受 Politico 播客《Decoded》采访时表示，世界应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件，以换取技术收益和用户自主权。

He said that one of the disagreements between OpenAI and some stricter AI safety advocates is the belief that "some bad things will happen" as society explores system resilience, and that regulation should take a lighter approach. 他说，OpenAI 与部分更严格的 AI 安全倡导者的分歧之一，是认为社会在探索系统韧性时「一些不好的事情将会发生」，监管应采取更轻的方式。

This statement was made during a discussion about the differences in AI safety approaches between OpenAI and Anthropic. 这段表态是在讨论 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的 AI 安全路线差异时提出的。

Altman believes that the benefits brought by AI will outweigh the harms by orders of magnitude; however, Gary Marcus, an honorary professor at New York University, criticized this argument, saying it turns social risks into the cost of corporate expansion. Both positions revolve around one question: once models are more widely open, which risks can society bear, and which need to be blocked before release? 奥特曼认为，AI 带来的好处数量级上会超过坏处；纽约大学荣誉教授 Gary Marcus 则批评这套说法把社会风险转成了公司扩张的代价。两种立场都围绕一个问题展开：模型被更广泛开放后，哪些风险可以由社会承担，哪些需要在发布前被挡住。

Altman's focus is on placing regulatory boundaries on system resilience and user choice: if risks can be discovered, explained, and fixed during use, he tends to let products enter real environments first; if risks can cause irreversible harm, restrictions should be set before release. 奥特曼的重点是把监管边界放在系统韧性和用户选择上：如果风险可以被发现、解释并在使用中修复，他倾向于让产品先进入真实环境；如果风险会造成不可逆伤害，则应在发布前设置限制。

Marcus's rebuttal, however, focuses on accountability, arguing that treating "some bad things will happen" as the cost of innovation might make affected individuals bear losses that should be borne by companies and regulators. Marcus 的反驳则集中在责任归属，认为把「会发生一些坏事」当成创新成本，可能让受影响的人承担本应由公司和监管者承担的损失。

item.title: 苹果要求开发者适配 iPhone Duo
item.guid: 苹果要求开发者适配-iPhone-Duo
item.description:
Recently, Apple announced on its official website that starting from April next year, all new applications and version updates submitted to App Store Connect must include application screenshot assets adapted for iPhone Duo, otherwise they will not pass review. 近日，苹果在官网发布公告，宣布从明年 4 月起，所有提交至 App Store Connect 的全新应用和版本更新，都必须附带适配 iPhone Duo 的应用截图素材，否则将无法通过审核。

The new rule applies to both App and Game categories, with no category exemptions. Developers need to upload screenshots of the application running in both outer screen and inner screen forms, for display on the App Store product page. 新规适用于 App 与游戏两大类，不设品类豁免。开发者需分别上传应用在外屏、内屏两种形态下的运行截图，用于 App Store 商品页展示。

Existing old applications are not affected, but once an update is submitted, screenshots must be supplemented. 已上架的旧应用不受影响，但一旦提交更新，就必须补齐截图。

The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable phone, launched on September 10. When closed, it features a 5.4-inch outer screen, and when unfolded, a 7.6-inch large screen. It comes pre-installed with iOS 27.1 and will open for pre-orders at 8 PM on October 16, with official sales starting on October 23. iPhone Duo 是苹果 9 月 10 日推出的首款折叠屏手机，闭合时为 5.4 英寸外屏，展开后为 7.6 英寸大屏，预装 iOS 27.1，将于 10 月 16 日 20 时开启预购，10 月 23 日正式发售。

To facilitate adaptation, Apple has provided Xcode 27.1 with a built-in iPhone Duo simulator, allowing developers to preview the running effects at different opening angles and orientations in Device Hub. Apple has also launched an application asset specification page, providing standards and template files for screenshot dimensions, layout, and preview videos. 为配合适配，苹果提供了内置 iPhone Duo 模拟器的 Xcode 27.1，开发者可在 Device Hub 中预览不同开合角度、横竖方向下的运行效果。苹果还上线了应用素材规范页面，提供截图尺寸、布局、预览视频的制作标准与模板文件。

item.title: 一加 16 定档 10 月 12 日，主打 185 FPS 游戏性能和 9000mAh 电池
item.guid: 一加-16-定档-10-月-12-日，主打-185-FPS-游戏性能和-9000mAh-电池
item.description:
The OnePlus 16 new product launch event will be held on October 12 at 7:00 PM. Information released by Li Jie, President of OnePlus China, indicates that the new phone will be equipped with Qualcomm's sixth-generation Snapdragon 8 Super Extreme Edition chip and a self-developed e-sports triple chip, focusing on native gaming performance running at 185 FPS. 一加 16 新品发布会将于 10 月 12 日 19:00 举行。一加中国区总裁李杰公布的信息显示，新机将搭载高通第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片和自研电竞三芯，主打原生跑满 185 FPS 的游戏表现。

The new phone will also feature a 200-megapixel main camera, LUMO Condensing Imaging System, 165Hz screen, and 9000mAh battery, and will run ColorOS 17; more pricing and availability information will be announced at the launch event. 新机还将配备 2 亿像素主摄、LUMO 凝光影像系统、165Hz 屏幕和 9000mAh 电池，并运行 ColorOS 17；更多价格和上市信息将在发布会公布。

item.title: Norsfell 公布《新神纪》，多神话开放世界将加入中国神话
item.guid: Norsfell-公布《新神纪》，多神话开放世界将加入中国神话
item.description:
Montreal studio Norsfell announced its new game "New Gods Chronicle" at the 3i program launch event. This is a top-down action RPG that combines survival and building gameplay, supporting single-player exploration and multiplayer cooperation; players will take on the role of "God-descendants" who survived Ragnarok, repairing the World Tree seed, recruiting followers, building temples, and challenging giant monsters. 加拿大蒙特利尔工作室 Norsfell 在 3i 计划发布会上公布新作《新神纪》。这是一款俯视角动作 RPG，融合生存建造玩法，支持单人探索和多人合作；玩家将扮演在诸神黄昏中幸存的「神裔」，修复世界树之种、招募追随者、建造神庙并挑战巨型怪物。

The game world will place Norse, Greek, and Egyptian mythologies in the same open world, with Chinese mythology content to be added later. The work is planned for Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, with the release date yet to be announced. 游戏世界将把北欧、希腊和埃及等神话体系放在同一开放世界中，后续还会加入中国神话内容。作品计划登陆 Steam、Epic Games Store、Xbox Series X|S 和 PlayStation 5，首发时间尚未公布。

item.title: 联想 YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark 开启中国市场预售，10 月 16 日开售
item.guid: 联想-YOGA-Pro-15-RTX-Spark-开启中国市场预售，10-月-16-日开售
item.description:
Lenovo announced on October 8 that the YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark (overseas model Yoga Pro 9n) has opened for pre-sale across China, with official sales starting on October 16. This is one of the world's first AI PCs equipped with NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X chips, targeting AI developers, professional creators, and high-performance computing users. 联想 10 月 8 日宣布，YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark（海外型号 Yoga Pro 9n）在中国市场开启全网预售，10 月 16 日正式开售。这是全球首批搭载英伟达 RTX Spark N1X 芯片的 AI PC 之一，面向 AI 开发者、专业创作者和高性能计算用户。

The machine is equipped with up to 128GB unified memory and 2TB SSD, featuring a maximum 20-core NVIDIA Grace CPU and a Blackwell RTX GPU with 6144 CUDA cores, offering a peak FP4 AI computing power of up to 1 PFLOPS; Lenovo states that the device supports running models with over a hundred billion parameters locally, and comes pre-installed with a 35B local large model and Tianxi AI Super Mode. The RTX Spark platform reduces the limitations of traditional discrete video memory capacity on local model deployment by sharing unified memory between the CPU and GPU. 该机最高配备 128GB 统一内存和 2TB SSD，采用最高 20 核 NVIDIA Grace CPU、6148 个 CUDA 核心的 Blackwell RTX GPU，FP4 AI 峰值算力最高可达 1 PFLOPS；联想称，设备支持在本地运行超过千亿参数模型，并预装 35B 本地大模型和天禧 AI 超能模式。RTX Spark 平台通过 CPU、GPU 共享统一内存，减少传统独立显存容量对本地模型部署的限制。

item.title: Vidu Q4 Preview 开放，支持 15 张参考图和 4K 输出
item.guid: Vidu-Q4-Preview-开放，支持-15-张参考图和-4K-输出
item.description:
Vidu AI 10 月 8 日开放 Vidu Q4 Preview，定位为新一代视频生成模型预览版。它最多支持 3 段参考音频、15 张参考图，以及 2K、4K 输出，重点强化人物表演、动态运镜、镜头衔接和复杂视效。

Vidu 同时公布首发优惠价 0.09 元/秒起，并称 Q4 Preview 将继续与创作者共创。官方示例覆盖参考图、参考音频、文生视频和图生视频等流程；价格为首发优惠，完整价格政策以官网为准。

item.title: 阶跃 STEPX Neo 智能体手机定档 10 月 13 日发布
item.guid: 阶跃-STEPX-Neo-智能体手机定档-10-月-13-日发布
item.description:
阶跃终端宣布，首款大模型原生智能体手机 STEPX Neo 将于 10 月 13 日 19:00 发布，发布会主题为「Ready Builder One」。这款手机今年 7 月已在世界人工智能大会亮相，定位是把大模型、智能体原生系统 Step AOS 和手机硬件结合起来。

STEPX Neo 的具体芯片、售价和上市安排将于发布会公布。

item.title: 《极限竞速：地平线 6》PS5 版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日
item.guid: 《极限竞速：地平线-6》PS5-版延期至-2027-年-1-月-26-日
item.description:
Playground Games 此前宣布《极限竞速：地平线 6》会在 2026 年登陆 PS5，如今确认主机版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日，并与新扩展包同日推出。PS5 Premium Edition 可提前最多 5 天游玩；Xbox 和 PC 版已于 5 月 15 日发售。

上一作《极限竞速：地平线 5》登陆 PS5 后表现突出，这次延期也让 PS5 版与新扩展内容一起上市。

item.title: 《三角洲行动》日活突破 5800 万，游戏葡萄复盘其增长路径
item.guid: 《三角洲行动》日活突破-5800-万，游戏葡萄复盘其增长路径
item.description:
《三角洲行动》近日宣布国服日活跃用户数突破 5800 万。游戏葡萄梳理称，该游戏日活从 2025 年 4 月的 1200 万、7 月的 2000 万和一周年时的 3000 万，增长到 2026 年 3 月的 5000 万，再到二周年和国庆假期后的最新数字。

文章提到，产品运营并未只围绕传统搜打撤玩法展开：玩家可以在地图里带其他队伍进入撤离点、吹口琴或跳舞，游戏也加入钓鱼、打牌等玩法；二周年活动还推出彩蛋关卡和「群星计划」，准备为干员制作独立叙事短片，并计划打造供玩家自行布置的「GTI 小屋」。

item.title: Omdia：2027 年高端电视出货量增长 9.3%，全球电视总出货量预计下降 1%
item.guid: Omdia：2027-年高端电视出货量增长-9.3%，全球电视总出货量预计下降-1%
item.description:
Omdia 预计，2027 年全球平均售价超过 1000 美元的高端电视出货量将同比增长 9.3%，而全球电视总出货量下降 1.0%。北美将成为高端电视增长最快的市场，出货量预计增长 21.9%。

Omdia 认为，存储和其他元器件成本上升正在挤压入门级电视利润，厂商会优先把紧张的零部件分配给高端机型。显示技术也在改变产品结构，RGB LED 背光预计到 2030 年将占全球高端电视收入的 49%。

item.title: 《赛博朋克 2077》将由派拉蒙开发真人电影
item.guid: 《赛博朋克-2077》将由派拉蒙开发真人电影
item.description:
派拉蒙影业正在开发一部设定于《赛博朋克 2077》世界观中的真人电影，项目由游戏开发商 CD Projekt Red 参与，Lorenzo di Bonaventura 担任制片人。影片将继续使用这个以科技、城市权力和身体改造为核心的未来世界，但故事和演员阵容尚未公布。

《赛博朋克 2077》及其资料片《往日之影》分别已售出超过 4000 万份和 1500 万份；CD Projekt Red 此前还与 Netflix 合作推出了同一世界观的动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》。

item.title: 2026 年国庆档票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%
item.guid: 2026-年国庆档票房-11.65-亿元，同比下降-36%
item.description:
国家电影局数据显示，2026 年国庆档（10 月 1 日至 7 日）全国电影票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%；观影人次约 3199.4 万，平均票价 36.4 元，均低于上一年同期。国产影片票房占比 78.7%，《神探之痕迹》以约 4.2 亿元成为档期票房冠军。

档期内连续 7 天单日票房破亿元，但总观影人次比上一年减少约 1800 万。票价降到近五年国庆档最低，仍未抵消影片供给和观影意愿变化带来的影响。

item.title: 《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日
item.guid: 《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档-10-月-17-日
item.description:
追光动画历史权谋电影《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日上映，并发布「王朝末日」版预告。影片由《长安三万里》原班主创团队制作，故事从东汉末年洛阳局势动荡展开，曹操、袁绍、何进、董卓、丁原和吕布等人物陆续登场。

该片此前曾上映，片方这次重新安排档期，并在预告中继续采用汉风美学呈现三国前夜的权力变化。
